translations.literal: Now at the change of season of the Three Primes and the beginning of the four seasons, we hope for peace, yet nothing is like litigation and imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: At the turn of the year and the beginning of the four seasons, peace was hoped for, yet nothing hindered it like litigation and imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 應三京、鄴都、諸道州府見系罪人，委逐處長吏躬親慮問，其於決斷，務在公平，但見其情，即為具獄，勿令率引，遂致淹停，無縱舞文，有傷和氣。

translations.literal: All prisoners now detained in the three capitals, the Yedu capital, and the prefectures and districts of all circuits are entrusted to the local chief officials to examine and question in person; in deciding, fairness must be pursued; once the circumstances are seen, complete the case record; do not allow leading and implicating others, thereby causing delay; do not indulge twisting of documents, harming harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners in the three capitals, Yedu, and the circuits were entrusted to local chief officials for personal examination; decisions were to be fair, cases completed once the facts were clear, without leading testimony that caused delay or twisting of documents that harmed harmonious order.

sentences.zh: 」四月甲午，敕曰：「月戒正陽，候當小暑，乃挺重出輕之日，是恤刑議獄之辰，有罪者速就勘窮，薄罰者畫時疏決，用符時令，勿縱滯淹。

translations.literal: " On the day jiawu of the fourth month, an edict stated: "The monthly warning is at upright yang; the season approaches minor heat; it is the day for drawing out the heavy and releasing the light, the time for compassionate punishment and deliberation on cases; the guilty should swiftly be investigated to the full, those with light penalties should be cleared and decided within the day, conforming to the seasonal ordinance, without allowing delay.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the fourth month, an edict noted that at upright yang and minor heat it was the season for easing punishments; the guilty were to be investigated swiftly and minor penalties cleared within the day, conforming to the season without delay.

sentences.zh: 三京、鄴都、諸道州府在獄見系罪人，宜令所司疾速斷遣，無致淹滯枉濫。

translations.literal: Prisoners now detained in the three capitals, the Yedu capital, and the prefectures and districts of all circuits should be ordered by the responsible offices to sentence and dispatch swiftly, without causing delay and wrongful abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners in the three capitals, Yedu, and all circuit prefectures were to be sentenced and dispatched swiftly by the responsible offices, without delay or injustice.

sentences.zh: 」五月辛未，敕：「政化所先，獄訟攸切，不惟枉撓，兼慮滯淹。

translations.literal: " On the day xinwei of the fifth month, an edict ordered: "What transformation through government puts first is litigation and imprisonment; we fear not only wrongful oppression but also delay.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the fifth month, an edict declared that government transformation put litigation first, fearing not only wrongful oppression but also delay.

sentences.zh: 適當長養之時，正屬熇蒸之候，累行條貫，俾速施行，靡不丁寧，未曾奏報，再頌告諭，無或因循。

translations.literal: Now at the season of nurturing growth, in the very time of blazing heat, regulations have repeatedly been issued to speed implementation; none has lacked earnest admonition, yet none has been reported in memorial; we again proclaim and instruct—there must be no following routine.
translations.idiomatic: At the season of growth and blazing heat, regulations had repeatedly been issued to speed implementation with earnest admonition, yet no reports had come; the edict was proclaimed again and routine was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 應三京、鄴都、諸道州府，詔至，宜具疏放已行未行申奏，無致逗留」

translations.literal: In the three capitals, the Yedu capital, and the prefectures and districts of all circuits, when the pronouncement arrives, they should fully report what releases have been carried out and what have not, without causing delay."
translations.idiomatic: When the edict reached the three capitals, Yedu, and all circuit prefectures, they were to report fully what releases had been carried out and what had not, without delay."

sentences.zh: 周廣順三年四月乙亥，敕：「朕以時當化育，氣屬炎蒸，乃思縲紲之人，是軫哀矜之念，慮其非所，案鞫淹延，或枉濫窮屈而未得申宣，或饑渴疾病而無所控告。

translations.literal: On the day yihai of the fourth month of the third year of Guangshun of Zhou, an edict ordered: "We, as the season is for nurturing transformation and the qi belongs to blazing heat, think of those in fetters and extend compassionate concern, fearing they are not in their proper place, that case interrogation is delayed, that some suffer wrongful abuse and exhaustion without being able to declare it, or hunger, thirst, and illness without any means of complaint.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the fourth month of Zhou Guangshun 3, an edict proclaimed that in the season of heat the emperor thought of those in fetters with compassionate concern, fearing wrongful detention, delayed interrogation, or hunger, thirst, and illness without means of complaint.

sentences.zh: 以罪當刑者，惟彼自召，法不可移；

translations.literal: Those who deserve punishment for crime have only themselves to blame; the law cannot be moved;
translations.idiomatic: Those who deserved punishment had only themselves to blame and the law could not be moved;

sentences.zh: 非理受苦者，為上不明，安得無慮。

translations.literal: those who suffer unreasonably do so because those above are not enlightened—how can we not be concerned?
translations.idiomatic: but those who suffered unreasonably did so because those above were not enlightened—how could the emperor not be concerned?

sentences.zh: 欽恤之道，夙宵靡寧。

translations.literal: The way of reverent compassion leaves us uneasy from early morning to late night.
translations.idiomatic: The way of reverent compassion left him uneasy from early morning to late night.

sentences.zh: 應諸道州府見系罪人，宜令官吏疾速推鞫，據輕斷遣，不得淹滯。

translations.literal: All prisoners now detained in the prefectures and districts of all circuits should be ordered by officials to investigate swiftly, sentence according to severity, and dispatch without delay.
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners in circuit prefectures were to be investigated and sentenced swiftly according to severity, without delay.

sentences.zh: 仍令獄吏，灑掃牢獄，當令虛歇；

translations.literal: Jail officers are further ordered to sprinkle and sweep the prisons, which should be kept empty and at rest;
translations.idiomatic: Jail officers were further ordered to clean the prisons, which should be kept empty and at rest;

sentences.zh: 洗滌枷械，無令蚤虱；

translations.literal: wash the cangues and fetters, not allowing fleas and lice;
translations.idiomatic: wash cangues and fetters and keep them free of fleas and lice;

sentences.zh: 供給水漿，無令饑渴。

translations.literal: supply water and drink, not allowing hunger and thirst.
translations.idiomatic: supply water and drink so that prisoners would not hunger or thirst.

sentences.zh: 如有疾患，令其家人看承，囚人無主，官差醫工診候，勿致病亡。

translations.literal: If there is illness, order their families to attend; if a prisoner has no master, officials shall assign physicians to examine, and must not allow death from disease.
translations.idiomatic: If prisoners fell ill, their families were to attend them; if they had no family, officials were to assign physicians so that disease would not cause death.

sentences.zh: 循典法之成規，順長嬴之時令，俾無淹滯，以致治平。

translations.literal: Follow the established regulations of canonical law, accord with the seasonal ordinance of full summer, so that there is no delay and good order is achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Following established law and the season of full summer, delay was to be avoided and good order achieved.

sentences.zh: 」又，賜諸州詔曰：「朕以敷政之勤，惟刑是重，既未能化人於無罪，則不可為上而失刑。

translations.literal: " Furthermore, an imperial pronouncement was granted to the prefectures stating: "We, in the diligence of spreading government, esteem punishment alone as weighty; since we have not yet been able to transform people to innocence, we cannot as rulers neglect punishment.
translations.idiomatic: A further pronouncement to the prefectures declared that in diligent government punishment was weighty; since people could not yet all be transformed to innocence, the ruler could not neglect punishment.

sentences.zh: 況時當長嬴，事貴清適，念囹圄之閉固，復桎梏之拘縻，處於炎蒸，何異焚灼。

translations.literal: Moreover, the season is full summer, when affairs value clarity and ease; we think of the closed solidity of prisons and again the binding restraint of shackles—placed in blazing heat, how is it different from burning?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at the height of summer, when clarity and ease were prized, the closed prisons and shackles in blazing heat were little different from burning.

sentences.zh: 在州及所屬刑獄見系罪人，卿可躬親錄問，省略區分。

translations.literal: Prisoners now detained in your prefecture and its subordinate prisons—you may personally record and question them, simplifying judgment.
translations.idiomatic: You should personally question all prisoners in your prefecture and its subordinate jails and simplify their cases.

sentences.zh: 於入務不行者，令俟務開系；

translations.literal: those for whom proceedings cannot proceed during court session, order detention until session opens;
translations.idiomatic: Those whose cases could not proceed during court session were to await the opening of session;

sentences.zh: 有理須伸者，速期疏決。

translations.literal: where right must be extended, promptly set a date for clearing and decision.
translations.idiomatic: where justice required redress, judgment was to be cleared promptly.

sentences.zh: 俾皆平允，無至滯淹。

translations.literal: So that all may be fair and even, without reaching delay.
translations.idiomatic: So that all would be fair and none would suffer delay.

sentences.zh: 又以獄吏逞任情之奸，囚人被非法之苦，宜加檢察，勿縱侵欺。

translations.literal: Moreover, because jail officers indulge wilful wrongdoing and prisoners suffer unlawful hardship, inspection should be increased and oppression must not be indulged.
translations.idiomatic: Because jail officers indulged their whims and prisoners suffered unlawful hardship, inspection was to be increased and oppression forbidden.

sentences.zh: 常令凈掃獄房，洗刷枷匣，知其饑渴，供與水漿，有病者聽骨肉看承，無主者遣醫工救療，勿令非理致斃，以致和氣有傷。

translations.literal: Constantly order the prison cells swept clean, cangues and cases washed, know their hunger and thirst and supply water and drink; if sick, permit kin to attend; if without master, send physicians to treat; do not allow unreasonable death, thereby harming harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: Prison cells were to be kept clean, cangues washed, hunger and thirst relieved, the sick attended by kin or physicians, and no one allowed to die unreasonably, lest harmonious order be harmed.

sentences.zh: 卿忠幹分憂，仁明蒞事，必能奉詔，體我用心，眷委於茲，興寐無已。

translations.literal: You are loyal and capable in sharing our cares, benevolent and clear in attending to affairs; you will surely be able to obey the edict, enter into our intent, and in this commission entrusted to you, rise and sleep without cease.
translations.idiomatic: You are loyal and capable, benevolent and clear in office; you will surely obey the edict, grasp my intent, and in this commission rise and sleep without rest.

sentences.zh: 余從敕命處分。」

translations.literal: I follow the edict's disposition."
translations.idiomatic: I follow the edict's orders."

sentences.zh: 內外官當贖之法，梁、唐皆無定制，多示優容，或因時分輕重。

translations.literal: The law of commutation for inner and outer officials—Liang and Tang both had no fixed regulations, mostly showing lenient tolerance, or according to the time distinguishing severity and leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The law of commutation for civil and military officials had no fixed regulations under Liang and Tang; leniency was often shown, or severity adjusted according to the times.

sentences.zh: 晉天福六年五月，尚書刑部員外郎李象請：「今後凡是散官，不計高低，若犯罪不得當贖，亦不得上請詳定院覆奏。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year of Tianfu of Jin, Vice Director of the Ministry of Punishments in the Department of State Affairs Li Xiang requested: "Hereafter, for all honorary officials, regardless of rank high or low, if they commit crimes they may not commute punishment, nor may they petition the Court of Detailed Deliberation for rehearing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Jin Tianfu 6, Vice Director Li Xiang of the Ministry of Punishments requested that henceforth all honorary officials, regardless of rank, might neither commute punishment nor petition the Court of Detailed Deliberation for rehearing.

sentences.zh: 應內外文武官，有品官者自從品官法，無品官有散試官者，應內外帶職廷臣賓從、有功將校等，並請同九品官例。

translations.literal: For civil and military officials inside and outside, those with ranked office follow the law for ranked officials; those without ranked office who have honorary probationary office, court ministers and attendants with concurrent posts inside and outside, meritorious commanders and the like—all are requested to follow the precedent for ninth-rank officials.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials with ranked posts were to follow the law for ranked officials; honorary probationary officials, court ministers and attendants with concurrent posts, and meritorious commanders were all to follow the precedent for ninth-rank officials.

sentences.zh: 其京都運巡使及諸道州府衙前職員、內外雜任鎮將等，並請準律，不得上請當贖。

translations.literal: Transport patrol commissioners of the capital, yamen staff of prefectures and districts in all circuits, miscellaneous appointees and garrison commanders inside and outside—all are requested to follow the statutes and may not petition for commutation.
translations.idiomatic: Capital transport patrol commissioners, yamen staff of circuit prefectures, miscellaneous appointees, and garrison commanders were to follow the statutes and might not petition for commutation.

sentences.zh: 其巡司馬步司判官，雖有曾歷品官者，亦請同流外職。

translations.literal: Patrol and cavalry and infantry commission judges, even if they have formerly held ranked office, are also requested to be treated like posts outside the regular stream.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol and cavalry and infantry commission judges, even if they had formerly held ranked office, were also to be treated like posts outside the regular stream.

sentences.zh: 準律。

translations.literal: Follow the statutes.
translations.idiomatic: They were to follow the statutes.

sentences.zh: 杖罪以下，依決罰例，徒罪以上，仍依當贖法。

translations.literal: For punishments of beating with the staff and below, follow the precedent for deciding penalty; for exile and above, still follow the commutation law.
translations.idiomatic: For beating and lesser penalties the precedent for deciding punishment applied; for exile and above, the commutation law still applied.

sentences.zh: 」至周顯德五年七月，新定《刑統》：「今後定罪，諸道行軍司馬、節度副使、副留守，準從五品官例；

translations.literal: " By the seventh month of the fifth year of Xiande of Zhou, in the newly fixed Comprehensive Criminal Code: "Hereafter in fixing punishment, circuit army marshals, vice commissioners of military governorship, and vice protectors follow the precedent for officials of the fifth rank and below;
translations.idiomatic: By the seventh month of Zhou Xiande 5, the newly fixed Comprehensive Criminal Code provided that circuit army marshals, vice commissioners, and vice protectors were to follow the precedent for fifth-rank officials and below;

sentences.zh: 諸道兩使判官、防禦團練副使，準從六品官例；

translations.literal: circuit commissioners' judges and vice commissioners of defense and training regiments follow the precedent for officials of the sixth rank and below;
translations.idiomatic: circuit commissioners' judges and vice commissioners of defense and training regiments followed the precedent for sixth-rank officials and below;

sentences.zh: 節度掌書記、團判官、兩蕃營田等使判官，準從七品官例；

translations.literal: military governorship secretaries, regiment judges, and judges of the commissioners for garrison farming in the two border regions follow the precedent for officials of the seventh rank and below;
translations.idiomatic: military governorship secretaries, regiment judges, and border garrison-farming commissioners' judges followed the precedent for seventh-rank officials and below;

sentences.zh: 諸道推巡及軍事判官，準從八品官例；

translations.literal: circuit investigation patrol and military judges follow the precedent for officials of the eighth rank and below;
translations.idiomatic: circuit investigation patrol and military judges followed the precedent for eighth-rank officials and below;

sentences.zh: 諸軍將校內諸司使、使副、供奉、殿直，臨時奏聽敕旨。

translations.literal: army commanders, inner-palace commissioners and vice commissioners, attendants, and palace guards—memorialize temporarily and await imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: army commanders, inner-palace commissioners and their deputies, attendants, and palace guards were to memorialize and await the imperial edict in each case.

sentences.zh: 」由是內外品官當贖之法，始有定制焉。

translations.literal: " Thereby the law of commutation for ranked officials inside and outside first had fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the law of commutation for civil and military ranked officials first received fixed regulations.
